in_marathi.name: Hiran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hiran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘hiranya’, meaning ‘golden’ or ‘radiant’. In Hindu mythology, Hiranyakashipu was a demon king who was granted a boon that he could not be killed by a god, man or animal. He was eventually killed by his own son, Prahlada, who was a devotee of Lord Vishnu.
